news.title: FIFA releases evaluation reports for the 2031 and 2035 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: CHENNAI The joint bids for both the 2031 and the 2035 Women’s World Cup tournaments have met the hosting requirements and will be put up for a vote by FIFA’s members later this month. The United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica made the lone bid for the 2031 tournament, when the field will be expanded from 32 to 48 teams. The joint bid for the 2035 edition includes England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. FIFA’s evaluation reports released Wednesday determined both bids met minimum requirements ahead of the voted on during the Extraordinary FIFA Congress on Nov.

news.title: US withdraws from U-17 football World Cup in Qatar over security fears
news.lede: Tensions in the Middle East have seen civilian infrastructure such as Saudi Arabia’s Abha International Airport come under attack on Oct 7. LOS ANGELES - The United States on Nov 11 withdrew from the upcoming Under-17 football World Cup in Qatar due to concerns about security in the Middle East. Players were informed of the decision just over a week before the tournament is due to begin on Nov 19, in a letter sent by the sport’s US governing body. “We are writing to inform you of the difficult decision to cancel our World Cup pre-camp and our planned participation in the World Cup,” said the letter, seen by AFP.

news.title: US withdraw from U-17 World Cup in Qatar due to safety concerns
news.lede: USSF cites state department advisory about Qatar. Competition set to kick off in eight days. The US men’s national team have pulled out of the Fifa U-17 World Cup, which is due to kick off in Qatar in just over a week. In a letter sent to players explaining the decision, the US Soccer Federation cited safety concerns for players and staff, referring them to the US state department’s travel advisory for Qatar, which encourages citizens to reconsider travel to the country “due to risk of armed conflict” and asks government employees to obtain special authorization to do so.

news.title: Women's European Qualifiers for 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup: Play-off second round starts 1 December
news.lede: Sixteen teams progressed to round 2 on 1 and 5 December, which will decide seven Women's World Cup berths and one inter-confederation play-off place. Round 1 of the Women's European Qualifiers play-offs is complete, with 16 teams through to round 2 on 1 and 5 December, which will have places at the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup at stake. While the four League A group winners (Denmark, France, Germany and Spain) have qualified directly for the finals in Brazil from 24 June to 25 July 2027, Europe's seven other berths, plus a slot in February's inter-confederation play-offs, are being settled by two rounds of home-and-away ties. Poland came through the most dramatic round 1 encounter; beginning the second leg in Gdansk 1-0 down to Belgium, they took it to extra time, where Ewa Pajor then equalised late on to force a penalty shoot-out.

news.title: Thibaut Courtois labels Real Madrid teammate ‘the best player at the World Cup’
news.lede: Real Madrid star Thibaut Courtois has revealed his take that teammate Jude Bellingham was the standout performer of any player at this past summer’s World Cup. Midfielder Bellingham of course enjoyed nothing short of a spectacular summer in the colours of England. En route to Thomas Tuchel’s troops battling their way to a semi-final finish at the World Cup, the former Borussia Dortmund talent at times almost single-handedly dragged his fellow countryman through fixtures. Bellingham racked up a remarkable seven goals from his midfield berth across the length of the tournament, including crucial doubles against both Mexico and Norway.
